authority: Root explicit predeclared paid-deployment view; no new solver run
rule: After all80 terminal and before GT read: select lower originalPhi among two existing paid incumbents; exact tie retains CIE
final_view: Each arm uses its frozen 480CPU eligible incumbent; all selected arrays and costs sealed before GT
deployment_cost: Sum two actual exact external childCPU costs, including setup/failures/serialization; overlapping campaign arms charged once in campaign total, but both candidates paid in each deployment scenario

prefix_view.selection: Only existing paid checkpoints eligible within per-arm caps; same Phi/tie-CIE rule
prefix_view.actual_spend: If arm naturally ended within prefix cap use exact actual childCPU; otherwise prefix is a saved-state allowed-budget slice and exact interrupted deployment spend is not observed; do not label allowed cap as equal actual cost

wall_policy: Do not call shared queue wall time a single deployment wall time
forbidden: Skipping a planned arm based on observed data
Claiming equal actual spend because allowed caps are equal
